mapper.select:
SELECT ni.node_id, ni.code, ni.name, ni.type, CASE ni.type WHEN 1 THEN '捕捞企业' WHEN 2 THEN '养殖企业' WHEN 3 THEN '冷冻加工企业' WHEN 4 THEN '批发商' WHEN 5 THEN '零售商' END AS type_name, ni.prov_id, p.prov_name, ni.city_id, c.city_name, ni.address, ni.business_id, ni.fishing_lic, ni.aquaculture_lic, ni.food_business_lic, ni.corporation, ni.telephone, ni.reg_date, ni.remarks FROM node_info ni LEFT JOIN province p ON ni.prov_id = p.prov_id LEFT JOIN city c ON ni.city_id = c.city_id
ni.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
ni.type = #{type}
ORDER BY ni.node_id DESC
